answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake, joins the Semaphore commitment tree, and evaluates an epoch polynomial under a polynomial identity commitment. Each message carries an RLN rate-limit nullifier and a membership proof. Honest use remains private, but duplicate messaging produces distinct Shamir shares of the same secret; interpolation reconstructs the agent’s private key, enabling immediate identification and instantaneous collateral slashing. Onyx, nadir, and pearl are merely transcript labels.
